description: In every PA-model, the actual parameterized fold retains the parameter in its paired accumulator.

  (c p z : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.unpairLeft.value
      ![(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.foldInto
              (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.paramFoldStep h)).value
          ![c, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.squarePair.value ![p, z]]] =
